name: Allen Baker
life: “I still remember finding an old voice in the middle of a music cassette.” Thursday often includes a stop at the corner by Juniper Tailor, where Allen looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I have recordings of him telling jokes before his stroke. The new carer laughed before the punchline was even finished.
appearance: Allen is easy to recognize by short sandy hair and a marked widow's peak and a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair, Allen gives a little nod before asking a hard question when listening.
personality: Allen has a quick wit and an equally quick sense of shame. A joke is often Allen's way of finding out whether a room is friendly enough for a serious question.
agenda: To bring the recorded jokes to a shared meal.
family: Logan Hamm is Allen’s younger cousin. Allen chooses the music. Logan puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The crane shadow*, Logan says, “I got teased for being sentimental. My foreman quietly gave me his lunch break to watch.”
connections: Ariel Pinto. A joke recorded before the stroke gives the interpreter a familiar voice to begin with.

reactions.situation: Someone asks a family member to translate an intimate question
reactions.response: Allen offers a qualified interpreter and lets the client decide how much family should hear.
reactions.asWritten: Someone asks a family member to translate an intimate question. Allen offers a qualified interpreter and lets the client decide how much family should hear.

reactions.situation: A friend asks for a loan due back before payday
reactions.response: Allen asks which other bill repayment would displace, then offers only what the household can afford to give.

reactions.response: Allen seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
reactions.asWritten: If the joke lands badly, Allen seeks out the person it hurt before telling anybody why it was supposed to be funny.
